The commonest mid-storey tree and the source of the biome's red dye. It is NOT an Earth animal: thick red sap bleeding from cuts and splits in the bark, running down the trunk; bark visibly split and cracked in many places, with red showing through the splits; gnarled trunk bent and leaning to one side as if shaped by wind, not upright; dense, rounded crown of medium-dark leaves. The bark is split in many long fissures along the trunk and limbs, each oozing thick dark-crimson sap that runs down in heavy red streaks visible at a glance. The crown is painted as dense, irregular, realistically shaded masses of medium-dark leaves, with a thin dark outline only at the silhouette edge. The leaves and bark carry a distinctly alien structure, such as an unusual leaf shape or bark plating, beyond a colour shift. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background.

prompt: tumbel: A thick runner arching up on woody props well above pawn height, carrying heavy hollow vessels slung along its length, each the size of a crate, dull and leathery-skinned. You walk under it and cannot see out through the vessels. Its hollow shells are cut into containers once harvested — the roster's own waypoint marker, visible from further away than a flat plant would be. It is NOT an Earth animal: a single thick runner arched up off the ground on woody prop-like supports, standing clearly taller than a pawn, not a vine trailing along the ground or climbing a trellis; crate-sized hollow vessels hung along the underside of the runner, far bigger than any gourd or pumpkin compared with a pawn; dull, matte, leathery vessel skin, with no glossy rind, ribbing or bright gourd colours; vessels hung close enough together along the arch that they form a solid wall, so nothing behind them shows through; a heavy, woody, trunk-thick runner with no thin curling tendrils or broad vine leaves. Draw a thick woody runner arching overhead from left to right, held up on two or three slanted woody prop-stems planted at the base, with the heavy vessels slung beneath the arch along its length. The vessels are closed, heavy, gourd-like hollow shells with thick dull leathery hide and no open pitcher mouth or lip, so they read as an invented crop rather than a carnivorous pitcher plant. Hang five or six uniformly crate-sized, closed, dull-skinned vessels densely along the runner so they wall off the view beneath it. The wood is rendered with plain realistic bark under even daylight, less ornately braided. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background.
